name: Apollo.io
summary: Sales platform with a database of B2B contacts, outreach sequences and AI agents for go-to-market teams.
description: Apollo.io combines a database of about 240 million contacts and 30 million companies with prospecting, email sequences, deal management and AI agents that run in the background. It connects to other tools and offers a builder for custom go-to-market systems. The Free plan includes 900 credits per seat per year; paid plans start at $49 per seat per month billed annually, with $79 and $119 tiers.

howToUse.title: Open Apollo.io
howToUse.description: Go to Apollo.io and choose Sign up for free. The database covers 30 million companies and about 240 million contacts.

howToUse.title: Prospect and run sequences
howToUse.description: Search contacts, then use prospecting, email sequences and deal management from the workspace.

howToUse.title: Run agents or Builder Studio
howToUse.description: Let the AI agents keep running in the background. Apollo connects to other tools, and Builder Studio is there for a custom go-to-market system. Free gives each seat 900 credits a year. Paid seats start at $49 per month on an annual bill, with further tiers at $79 and $119.
